fulltext_evidence.text: 可见熄焰直径指可见火焰熄灭时的液滴直径。液滴提前离开相机视场时，作者有时按足够长的燃烧记录外推；记录不足时，作者不列直径。
fulltext_evidence.conditions: FLEX 液滴实验，依据高速背光相机记录
fulltext_evidence.scope: 报告对表 IX 指标和缺失值的定义
fulltext_evidence.limitation: 表中已填的直径可能来自直接测量或外推。外推方法与缺值处理见报告附录 A.1。

en.text: Visible flame extinction diameter is the droplet diameter when the visible flame goes out. When a droplet left the camera view early, the authors sometimes extrapolated from a sufficiently long burn record. They left the diameter blank when the record was too short.
en.conditions: FLEX droplet experiments with high-speed backlit imaging
en.scope: The report’s definitions for Table IX measurements and missing values
en.limitation: Reported diameters may be measured or extrapolated. Appendix A.1 describes extrapolation and the treatment of missing values.

case_study.scope: 记录按 CSV 行计数。第 2–275 行对应 FLEX 试验号 1–274，其中试验号 1–31 可对照报告表 IX（印刷页 20）。
case_study.missing_notes: 图表与区间使用表中可用的精确值。原表的缺值标记、约数、待核零值和零气体摩尔分数保留在表格及导出中。气流、流向与纤维支撑需另查试验资料。

en.label: Droplet diameter at visible flame extinction

en.scope: Records are counted by CSV row. Rows 2–275 cover FLEX test IDs 1–274. Tests 1–31 can also be located in Table IX on printed page 20.
en.missing_notes: Charts and ranges use the available exact entries. The table and exports retain missing-value markers, approximate values, unverified zeros, and zero gas mole fractions. Airflow, flow direction, and fiber support require separate experiment records.

claims.text: BASS-II 考察氧浓度、通风速度及固体燃料类型、厚度和几何。
claims.limitation: 各变量的影响需结合对应试验结果判断。
claims.checked: 对照公开摘要核对；非原始运行复核

en.text: BASS-II examined oxygen concentration, ventilation speed and the type, thickness and geometry of solid fuels.
en.limitation: Assessing the effect of each variable requires the corresponding test results.

claims.text: 报告使用每次试验前后的 O₂、CO 和 CO₂ 读数。
claims.limitation: 分析试验中的连续变化需要传感器时间序列。
claims.checked: 对照公开摘要核对；非原始运行复核

en.text: The report used O₂, CO and CO₂ readings taken before and after each test.
en.limitation: Changes during the test require a sensor time series.

claims.text: 摘要报告大多数试验的热释放率远低于 100 W。
claims.limitation: 100 W 对应作者对多数试验的汇总。分析极值需查看逐次试验数据。
claims.checked: 对照公开摘要核对；非原始运行复核

en.text: The abstract reports that heat release rates were well below 100 W for most tests.
en.limitation: The 100 W statement summarizes most tests. Assessing extremes requires individual test results.

claims.text: Saffire IV/V 在离开 ISS 后的在轨 Cygnus 飞船内研究较大尺度火焰。
claims.limitation: 与 BASS-II 做定量比较时，需要同时考虑平台、试验尺度和材料。
claims.checked: 对照公开摘要核对；非原始运行复核

en.text: Saffire IV/V studied larger flames aboard the Cygnus spacecraft in orbit after it departed the ISS.
en.limitation: A quantitative comparison with BASS-II requires considering the platform, test scale, and materials together.

claims.text: 实验包含火焰蔓延、氧量热以及分布式舱内温度和气体测量。
claims.limitation: 分析读数随时间的变化需要各传感器的时间序列。
claims.checked: 对照公开摘要核对；非原始运行复核

en.text: The experiments included flame spread observations, oxygen calorimetry, and cabin temperature and gas measurements at multiple locations.
en.limitation: Analyzing changes over time requires the sensor time series.

claims.text: 摘要描述火灾对飞船压力、温度和 CO₂ 浓度产生了可测影响。
claims.limitation: 这些变化对应 Cygnus 舱内的试验条件。
claims.checked: 对照公开摘要核对；非原始运行复核

en.text: The abstract describes measurable effects of the fires on spacecraft pressure, temperature and CO₂ concentration.
en.limitation: These changes reflect the test conditions aboard Cygnus.

claims.text: SAME-2 将材料加热至点火温度以下，样品附近气流从静止到 8 cm/s。
claims.limitation: 分析粒径与气流的关系需要同次试验的配对读数。
claims.checked: 对照公开摘要核对；非原始运行复核

en.text: SAME-2 heated materials below ignition, with airflow near the samples ranging from still air to 8 cm/s.
en.limitation: Relating airflow to particle size requires paired readings from each test.

claims.text: 实验通过 11–1800 s 的烟雾老化停留时间模拟不同输运时间。
claims.limitation: 所列数值是实验设定的老化时间。评估探测延迟需要目标航天器的输运和探测器响应数据。
claims.checked: 对照公开摘要核对；非原始运行复核

en.text: The experiment used smoke aging residence times of 11–1,800 s to simulate different transport times.
en.limitation: The reported times describe smoke aging in the experiment. Assessing detection delay requires transport and detector response data for the spacecraft of interest.

claims.text: 报告中多数平均烟雾粒径处于 200–400 nm，部分静止气流案例更大。
claims.limitation: 平均粒径描述每组颗粒的平均值。分析颗粒分布需要单颗粒或分布数据。
claims.checked: 对照公开摘要核对；非原始运行复核

en.text: Most reported mean smoke particle diameters were 200–400 nm. Some tests in still air produced larger means.
en.limitation: Mean diameters summarize groups of particles. Analyzing the particle size distribution requires individual readings or distribution data.

claims.text: FLEX 在 ISS 燃烧集成架内使用 MDCA 装置开展液滴燃烧试验。
claims.limitation: 固体材料上的火焰蔓延可参考相应的固体燃烧试验。
claims.checked: 对照公开摘要核对；非原始运行复核

en.text: FLEX tested burning droplets in the MDCA inside the ISS Combustion Integrated Rack.
en.limitation: Flame spread on solid materials calls for evidence from solid combustion tests.
